payload.name: Pillr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pillr gives free, no-login access to French real estate public data: the price per square meter for any municipality, a market summary (rent, yield, price trends, zoning), and the permit or declaration requirements for a renovation project. Every figure is sourced from official public data (DVF, DHUP, INSEE) and French urbanism law, with no listings, no addresses, and no proprietary scoring shown.
payload.longDescription: Pillr 免费提供无需登录的法国房地产公共数据：任何市镇的每平方米价格、市场摘要（租金、收益率、价格趋势、分区），以及翻修项目所需的许可或申报要求。每个数字均来自官方公共数据（DVF、DHUP、INSEE）和法国城市规划法；不会显示房源、地址或专有评分。

payload.name: Statiko
payload.description: 搜索 Telegram 频道数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Statiko brings public Telegram channel data into ChatGPT, so you can research what's happening on Telegram without leaving the conversation.

Ask what's trending across tracked channels in the last 24 hours, then read the actual posts behind a story to see what it's about. Look up any tracked channel for its profile, subscriber count and growth, posting frequency, view rate and engagement - or compare up to ten channels side by side in a single answer. Find channels similar to one you already follow, search a  channel's own posts by keyword or date range, and trace how a specific post's views, forwards and reactions built up hour by hour.

Every answer links back to the source page on statiko.io, so you can check the numbers yourself.

Statiko is read-only: it looks up public channel data and never posts, joins or messages on your behalf. Connecting requires a Statiko account on the Pro or Business plan.
payload.longDescription:
Statiko 将 Telegram 公开频道数据带入 ChatGPT，让你无需离开对话即可研究 Telegram 上的动态。

询问过去 24 小时内哪些内容在已追踪频道中走红，然后阅读相关原帖，了解事件详情。查询任何已追踪频道的资料、订阅者数量及增长情况、发帖频率、浏览率和互动度，也可以在单个答案中并排比较最多十个频道。查找与你已关注频道相似的频道；按关键词或日期范围搜索某个频道自己的帖子；还可以按小时追踪特定帖子的浏览、转发和回应如何增长。

每个答案都会链接到 statiko.io 上的来源页面，方便你自行核对数据。

Statiko 为只读服务：它只查询公开频道数据，不会代表你发帖、加入频道或发送消息。连接需要 Statiko Pro 或 Business 套餐账户。

Choose which Instagram accounts to share and disconnect at any time. Available data depends on your TVS subscription.

payload.name: TuneWorks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TuneWorks connects ChatGPT to your performance vehicle workspace, giving you access to the build history, setup data, sessions, maintenance, ECU logs, and other information behind each vehicle.

Analyze performance data, compare setup revisions, review driving sessions, diagnose problems, track maintenance, manage shop and event preparation, and use the history of a build to understand what changed and decide what to test next. TuneWorks keeps logs, setups, sessions, charts, notes, and vehicle information connected so decisions are based on the full context of the build.

TuneWorks supports both read and write actions, allowing you to retrieve information and take action directly from ChatGPT. You can also collaborate around shared vehicles and builds, maintain an ongoing performance history, and share selected build information with tuners, teammates, shops, or crew.
payload.longDescription:
TuneWorks 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的高性能车辆工作区，让你访问每辆车的改装历史、设置数据、驾驶会话、维护记录、ECU 日志及其他信息。

分析性能数据、比较设置版本、查看驾驶会话、诊断问题、追踪维护情况、管理车间作业和赛事准备，并利用改装历史了解发生了哪些变化以及下一步应测试什么。TuneWorks 将日志、设置、会话、图表、笔记和车辆信息关联起来，让你基于改装的完整背景做出决定。

TuneWorks 同时支持读取和写入操作，因此你可以直接通过 ChatGPT 获取信息并执行操作。你还可以与他人协作管理共享车辆和改装项目、持续维护性能历史，并与调校师、队友、维修店或团队成员分享选定的车辆改装信息。

payload.name: Converly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Converly is the easiest way to send conversions to Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, and more when someone submits a form, schedules an appointment or starts a chat on your site.

This plugin makes it super easy to set up. You simply say things like 'Send conversions to ChatGPT Ads when someone submits the contact form on my website' and the plugin will set up a conversion flow, give you a snippet of code to add to your site, and test that it's all set up and working.

It can detect conversions in 100+ tools, including Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Typeform, Jotform, Webflow Forms, Wix Forms, Squarespace Forms, Calendly, Acuity Scheduling, Cal.com & more.

It can send conversions to 20+ destinations, including Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads and more.

Converly supports conditional logic so you can decide exactly when a conversion fires, such as when someone submits your Quote Request form but not your Contact Support form.

Instead of relying on the visitor's browser to send conversions, Converly sends conversions directly to the ad platforms' servers, where ad blockers and privacy restrictions in iOS and Safari can't get in the way.

It also captures the lead's name, email, phone, click IDs, IP address, device, etc and sends it with the conversion. This gives ad platforms the data they need to match the conversion back to a real person and the original ad they clicked. Ultimately, this means you get more accurate conversion data, and your ad platform can understand what a good lead looks like for your business so it can go find more of them.

Converly gives you a full debug log that shows exactly what was captured, what was sent where, and whether it arrived successfully. You can even query it through the plugin by saying something like 'Is my conversion tracking working properly' and it will query the log and respond.
payload.longDescription:
当有人在您的网站提交表单、预约或开始聊天时，Converly 是向 Google Ads、Meta Ads、ChatGPT Ads、Microsoft Ads、LinkedIn Ads、Google Analytics 4 等发送转化的简单方式。

设置非常容易。您只需说“有人提交网站联系表单时，将转化发送到 ChatGPT Ads”，插件就会设置转化流程、提供要添加到网站的代码片段，并测试配置是否正常。

它可在 100+ 个工具中检测转化，包括 Gravity Forms、WPForms、Contact Form 7、Typeform、Jotform、Webflow Forms、Wix Forms、Squarespace Forms、Calendly、Acuity Scheduling、Cal.com 等。

它可将转化发送到 20+ 个目标，包括 Google Analytics、Google Ads、Meta Ads、ChatGPT Ads、Microsoft Ads、LinkedIn Ads、TikTok Ads、Reddit Ads 等。

Converly 支持条件逻辑，让您精确决定何时触发转化，例如有人提交报价请求表单时触发，但提交支持联系表单时不触发。

Converly 不依赖访客浏览器发送转化，而是直接发送到广告平台服务器，因此广告拦截器以及 iOS 和 Safari 的隐私限制不会阻碍它。

它还会捕获潜客姓名、电子邮件、电话、点击 ID、IP 地址、设备等，并随转化发送。这样广告平台可以将转化匹配到真实用户及其点击的原始广告，最终获得更准确的转化数据，并让广告平台了解什么样的潜客适合您的业务，从而寻找更多类似潜客。

Converly 提供完整调试日志，显示捕获了什么、发送到哪里以及是否成功到达。您还可以通过插件询问“我的转化跟踪正常吗？”，它会查询日志并回答。

payload.name: Epinium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask about your Amazon business and get the answer from your own data, without exporting a spreadsheet.

Epinium reads your catalog, your advertising and your automations:

• Catalog — one product entity that merges the Seller Central, Vendor Central and Advertising views of the same ASIN, with brands, barcodes and keyword clusters.

• Advertising — campaigns, ad groups, targets and product ads across Sponsored Products, Brands and Display, with budgets and bidding strategies.

• Performance — spend, sales, ACOS, ROAS, clicks and impressions per campaign, ad group, target, product ad and shopper search term. Seller Central sessions, Buy Box share, conversion rate and Best Seller Rank. Vendor Central manufacturing and sourcing figures reported separately, the way the two models actually work.

• Automations — what each workflow is set up to do, which campaigns it processes, and how those campaigns performed since it started optimizing them.

Typical questions: which campaigns had the worst ACOS last month, which search terms are burning budget without producing orders, which products get traffic but do not convert, what a workflow has actually been doing.

Results come back as an interactive table you can sort and drill into.

The plugin only reads. It never changes a bid, a budget or a listing. Requires an Epinium account with at least one Amazon connection.

payload.name: Cubi Estate
payload.description: 用 AI 查找房地产
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cubi Estate is an AI-native property search engine for Europe. The plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to a continuously updated corpus of over one million active sale and rental listings across Europe — Portugal, Spain, Italy, France, Germany and more — searchable in 7 languages. Tools cover natural-language search ("2-bed apartment in Porto under €400k with a balcony"), structured filtering, full listing details with source links, and day-by-day market statistics (new listings, deactivations, price drops, per country). Every result links back to its original source listing. All tools are read-only and annotated as such; nothing mutates data, and no user accounts are required.
payload.longDescription: Cubi Estate 是面向欧洲的 AI 原生房产搜索引擎。该插件为 ChatGPT 提供只读访问，覆盖欧洲持续更新的超过 1,000,000 条在售和出租房源——包括葡萄牙、西班牙、意大利、法国、德国等——支持 7 种语言搜索。工具包括自然语言搜索（“波尔图 400k 欧元以下带阳台的 2 居室公寓”）、结构化筛选、带来源链接的完整房源详情，以及逐日市场统计（按国家统计新房源、下架和降价）。每个结果都链接回原始房源。所有工具均为只读并明确标注；不会修改数据，也无需用户账户。

payload.name: Mavvrik

Built for FinOps practitioners, cloud engineers, and anyone who needs fast cost intelligence without manually filtering reports. Current coverage includes Cloud Cost, Cost Variances, Recommendations, and Anomalies across your connected cloud accounts.
payload.longDescription: Mavvrik 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Mavvrik 租户，让你无需打开仪表盘，就能针对实际数据查询云成本。用日常语言询问支出趋势、成本驱动因素、预算差异、异常情况和节省建议。适用于 FinOps 从业者、云工程师，以及任何需要快速了解成本情况、无需手动筛选报告的人。目前涵盖已连接云账户中的 Cloud Cost、Cost Variances、Recommendations 和 Anomalies。

payload.name: TubeLab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TubeLab gives ChatGPT read-only access to public YouTube data, enriched for niche research and ideation.

Typical uses: finding unsaturated niches; competition research; outlier ideation; video summarization; analysing video comments for content ideas.

12 tools cover:
• Channel Search: filter YouTube channels by recency, view count, subscribers, upload volume, consistency, language, estimated audience (region, age, gender, income), revenue, RPM and 40+ filters
• Related Channels: find channels similar to any channel, ideal for competition research
• Outlier Videos Search: search videos going viral in your niches, great for ideation
• Related Outliers: search viral videos similar to another video
• Trending Formats: the title formulas working right now in any niche, with the videos that used them and how fast they are spreading
• Videos: title, description, keywords, view and like counts and all metadata
• Channels: profile, videos and shorts. Takes a channel ID, URL or @handle
• Transcripts: caption text with timestamps, in the available language
• Comments: get a sample of 100 comments of a video

TubeLab is read-only. It cannot publish, subscribe, or moderate anything on YouTube.
payload.longDescription:
TubeLab为ChatGPT提供对公共YouTube数据的只读访问权限，数据经过增强处理，专为细分领域研究和创意构思设计。

典型应用场景：发现未饱和的细分领域；竞争分析研究；异常值创意构思；视频摘要生成；分析视频评论获取内容灵感。

12个工具涵盖：
• 频道搜索：通过最新度、观看次数、订阅数、上传量、更新频率、语言、预估受众（地区、年龄、性别、收入）、收入、RPM及40+项过滤条件筛选YouTube频道
• 相关频道：根据任意频道查找相似频道，适用于竞争分析
• 异常值视频搜索：搜索您细分领域内正在病毒式传播的视频，适用于创意构思
• 相关异常值：搜索与另一支视频相似的热门视频
• 热门格式：当前任何细分领域中有效的时间公式，包含使用该公式的视频及其传播速度
• 视频：标题、描述、关键词、观看次数和点赞数及所有元数据
• 频道：资料档案、视频和短视频。支持输入频道ID、URL或@名称
• 字幕：带时间戳的字幕文本，使用可用语言呈现
• 评论：获取视频的100条评论样本

TubeLab为只读模式。
无法在YouTube上进行发布、订阅或内容管理操作。

payload.name: Querypanel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
QueryPanel lets an AI agent configure analytics for a SaaS product without bypassing workspace permissions. Connect data sources, inspect schema context, generate and execute SQL, train business knowledge, and create charts or dashboards through one OAuth-protected MCP server.

The workspace identity comes from the validated OAuth token, so tool arguments cannot switch organizations. Database credentials and private SDK keys are not returned by read tools.
payload.longDescription:
QueryPanel允许AI代理为SaaS产品配置分析功能，而不会绕过工作区权限。通过一个经过OAuth保护的MCP服务器，连接数据源、检查模式上下文、生成并执行SQL、训练业务知识，以及创建图表或仪表板。

工作区身份来源于经过验证的OAuth令牌，因此工具参数无法切换组织。只读工具不会返回数据库凭证和私有SDK密钥。

payload.name: DATAV3 Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search millions of Australian court, tribunal, regulatory, and other government records that are or were publicly available and have been indexed by DATAV3. Find records by name, topic, ABN or ACN, narrow results by source and date, and retrieve the available documents and details behind a match. A DATAV3 account is required.
payload.longDescription: 搜索数百万份澳大利亚法院、法庭、监管及其他政府记录，这些记录曾经或现在公开，并且已被DATAV3索引。通过名称、主题、ABN或ACN查找记录，按来源和日期缩小结果范围，获取匹配项的相关文件和详细信息。需要DATAV3账户。

payload.name: Autosheet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Autosheet lets ChatGPT run a specialized spreadsheet agent directly in Google Sheets. Describe what you need in plain language — the agent inspects the spreadsheet, plans the steps, performs work, and reports back.

Delegate most tasks involving a Google Sheet including simply reading data or inspecting structure — it's reliable, fast, token-efficient, and helps keep context clean.

Everyday tasks:
- Create, fix, and explain formulas
- Build charts, pivot tables, and dashboards
- Format and style cells, ranges, and entire sheets
- Restructure data into clean, organized rows, columns, and sheets
- Web research

Row-by-row bulk processing with AI at up to 1,000 rows per minute:
- Enrich and categorize product catalogs for e-commerce and merchandising
- Generate, rewrite, and translate content at scale for SEO and localization
- Enrich and score leads for sales outbound through bulk web search
- Clean, standardize, and deduplicate messy data across any dataset

Beyond these, teams use Autosheet wherever work lives in a spreadsheet: accounting, finance, HR, inventory, education, and more.

How it works:

Give ChatGPT a prompt and a Google Sheets URL or ID. Autosheet launches an agent on that spreadsheet and returns the result. Long jobs keep running server-side — check status or stop an agent at any time. Follow-up requests continue on the same spreadsheet with full context. The agent works directly in the spreadsheet and can add, change, or remove content.

Authentication through OAuth: you grant access to your own Google Sheets. Works with any spreadsheet you can edit.

Built by Talarian, the team behind the GPT for Sheets and Docs add-on (7M+ installs on the Google Workspace Marketplace). New accounts start with free trial credits.
payload.longDescription:
Autosheet让ChatGPT可以直接在Google Sheets中运行专用的电子表格代理。用自然语言描述你的需求——代理会检查电子表格，规划步骤，执行工作并返回结果。

可以委托大多数涉及Google Sheets的任务，包括单纯的数据读取或结构检查——它可靠、快速、高效，并能保持上下文清晰。

日常任务：
- 创建、修复并解释公式
- 制作图表、数据透视表和仪表盘
- 格式化和美化单元格、区域和整个工作表
- 将数据重新整理成整洁有序的行、列和工作表
- 网络调研

每分钟可处理1000行的AI批量处理：
- 为电商和商品管理丰富和分类产品目录
- 批量生成、重写和翻译内容用于SEO和本地化
- 通过批量网络搜索为销售外呼丰富和评分潜在客户
- 清理、标准化并去重任何数据集中的混乱数据

除了这些功能，任何工作内容存在于电子表格中的场景，团队都会使用Autosheet：会计、财务、人力资源、库存、教育等领域皆适用。

如何运作：

给ChatGPT一个指令和一个Google Sheets的URL或ID。
Autosheet会在该电子表格上启动代理并返回结果。
长时间任务会在服务器端持续运行——随时可以查看状态或停止代理。
后续请求会继续在同一个电子表格上进行，保持完整上下文。
代理直接在电子表格中工作，可以添加、修改或删除内容。

通过OAuth进行身份验证：您可授权访问自己的Google Sheets，支持任何可编辑的电子表格。

由Talarian团队开发，该团队曾推出GPT for Sheets and Docs插件（在Google Workspace Marketplace拥有700万+安装量）。新账户可获得免费试用积分。

payload.name: Acquisition.gov by 1102tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Independent, unofficial app developed by James Jenrette / 1102tools using public data from Acquisition.gov. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.

Explore FAR Overhaul model parts, find posted agency deviations, retrieve deviation documents, and read official FAQs and guidance through five read-only tools. Review source links, dates, and document text while keeping model language distinct from agency adoption. The app provides source material and does not change regulations, issue deviations, or determine which rules govern a specific procurement.
payload.longDescription:
由James Jenrette/1102tools开发的独立非官方应用，使用来自Acquisition.gov的公开数据开发。该应用未得到美国政府的关联或认可。

通过五个只读工具探索FAR改革模型模块，查找已发布的机构偏差，检索偏差文件，并阅读官方FAQ和指南。在保持模型语言与机构采用内容区别的同时，可查看来源链接、日期和文档内容。该应用仅提供原始资料，不修改法规、发布偏差或确定特定采购适用的规则。

payload.name: LinkedIn Career Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
rankedin turns your authorized LinkedIn export data into career intelligence. Understand profile strength, AI resilience, network health, anonymized peer benchmarks where available, career direction, and practical improvement opportunities. See aggregate network changes over time.

rankedin does not scrape LinkedIn, post to LinkedIn, change account data, or expose individual connection details.
payload.longDescription:
rankedin将您的经授权LinkedIn导出数据转化为职业洞察。了解档案强度、AI韧性、网络健康度、可用的匿名同行基准、职业发展方向及实际提升机会。查看整体网络变动趋势。

rankedin不会抓取LinkedIn数据、向LinkedIn发布内容、修改账户数据或泄露个人联系人信息。

payload.name: Social Index
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Since 2013, Social Index has been the industry standard for measuring earned media value and campaign ROI. Over 3,000 companies rely on the Index, along with platforms like Brandwatch, Sprout Social, and Julius, to validate the true value of a social marketing investment.

Measure the earned media value and ROI of influencer, content marketing, PR, organic, and paid social campaigns. Query daily EMV rates across 15 social platforms, 9 industry verticals, and key NA, EMEA, and APAC markets, with 19+ months of historical lookback. Retrieve the full rate card for any segment, pull the latest value for a given metric and date range, and compute the Earned Media Value of specific Instagram or TikTok posts directly from their URLs. The assistant can list every valid region, vertical, platform, and metric, so queries resolve against real segments.

Social Index MCP access is included with Enterprise API plans.
payload.longDescription:
自2013年以来，Social Index一直是衡量获得的媒体价值和活动投资回报率的行业标准。超过3000家企业依赖该指数，以及Brandwatch、Sprout Social和Julius等平台，来验证社交媒体营销投资的真实价值。

测量影响者营销、内容营销、公关、自然和付费社交活动的获得媒体价值及投资回报率。查询15个社交平台、9个行业垂直领域以及北美、欧洲、中东、亚太关键市场的每日EMV费率，支持19个月以上的历史数据回溯。可获取任意细分领域的完整费率表，提取特定指标和日期范围的最新数值，并直接通过Instagram或TikTok的网址计算特定帖子的获得媒体价值。助手可列出所有有效区域、垂直领域、平台和指标，确保查询准确对应实际数据段。

Social Index MCP访问权限包含在企业API计划中。

payload.name: LeagueSaga
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect LeagueSaga to ask questions about your fantasy football league history. Explore championships, standings, records, matchups, drafts, managers, and seasons using read-only facts from leagues you can access. Results include LeagueSaga source links and coverage notes so you can verify the answer. LeagueSaga checks your account, league membership, and eligible access on every request. The plugin cannot change league data.
payload.longDescription:
将LeagueSaga连接以询问关于你的幻想足球联赛历史的问题。
通过访问的联赛只读数据，探索冠军、排名、战绩、对阵、选秀、经理和赛季等信息。
结果包含LeagueSaga来源链接和备注说明，方便您验证答案。
LeagueSaga会在每次请求时检查您的账户、联赛会员资格和可访问权限。
该插件无法修改联赛数据。

payload.name: Genseo
payload.description: 追踪AI可见性及搜索引擎优化
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Genseo account to inspect AI visibility, tracked prompts, competitors, cited sources, SEO opportunities, audits, and drafts, then publish approved content with role and Agent Autonomy controls.
payload.longDescription: 连接您的Genseo账户以查看AI可见性、追踪的提示内容、竞争对手、引用来源、SEO优化机会、审计结果和草稿，然后通过角色和代理自主控制功能发布已批准的内容。

payload.name: Intentwise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Intentwise AI Gateway is the intelligence layer between your commerce data and your AI assistant. Built on the Intentwise Commerce Observability Platform, it unifies advertising, retail, inventory, and competitive signals across Amazon, Walmart, Criteo, Meta, TikTok, Google, and other marketplaces into one connected, AI-ready foundation — the ground truth for both people and AI agents to act on

Ask deep business questions in plain English and get accurate, domain-specific answers. A structured semantic layer, enriched with your own taxonomies and brand context, interprets commerce signals correctly and reduces hallucinations, so responses reflect the real structure and language of your business. No SQL, no waiting on dashboards. Diagnose what's driving performance, compare periods, spot trends, break results down by campaign, product, or marketplace, and build custom reports on demand.

AI Gateway also turns visibility into controlled execution — discovering audiences and targets and building campaigns, always with your confirmation before anything changes. As the platform grows, the Gateway continues to expand across intelligence, automation, and agent-driven workflows.

Read capabilities retrieve and analyze your data; write capabilities act only after you approve.
payload.longDescription:
Intentwise AI网关是连接您的商业数据与AI助手的智能层。
基于Intentwise商业可观测性平台，它将亚马逊、沃尔玛、Criteo、Meta、TikTok、谷歌及其他电商平台的广告、零售、库存和竞争信号整合到一个互联的AI就绪基础架构中——这是人与AI代理可据此行动的真相基础

用自然英语提出深度业务问题并获取精准的领域特定答案。
通过结构化语义层，并结合您自有的分类体系和品牌背景，准确解析商业信号并减少幻觉现象，使回应能真实反映您业务的结构和语言。
无需SQL，无需等待仪表盘。
诊断表现驱动因素，对比不同时期，发现趋势，按活动、产品或电商平台拆解结果，并按需构建定制报告

AI网关还能将可见性转化为可控执行——发现受众和目标并创建活动，任何变更都需您确认后才生效。
随着平台发展，网关将持续扩展至智能、自动化和代理驱动的工作流领域

读取功能用于检索和分析您的数据；写入功能仅在您批准后才会执行

payload.name: Statable
payload.summaryOriginal: Read and set up web analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Statable is privacy-friendly web analytics. This plugin points ChatGPT at your own numbers, so "how did the pricing page do last week" becomes a real query against your site instead of a guess.

Read what the dashboard draws: visitors over time, top pages, sources, countries, custom events, goal completions, funnel reports and who is on the site right now. Break the numbers down and filter them the same way the dashboard does.

It also sets sites up. Add a website and get its tracking snippet, create and edit goals and funnels, adjust tracking settings and site filters. It cannot alter or delete the analytics themselves, and there is no delete tool of any kind.

Sign in once through your browser. Nothing to paste, no key to create, no configuration beyond the server address. Statable collects no cookies, needs no analytics consent banner, and hosts the data in the EU.
payload.longDescription:
Statable是隐私友好的网络分析工具。该插件将ChatGPT指向您的数据，因此「定价页面上周表现如何」会变成针对您网站的真实查询，而非猜测。

查看仪表盘展示的数据：随时间变化的访客数、热门页面、流量来源、国家分布、自定义事件、目标完成情况、漏斗报告以及当前在线用户。您可以像仪表盘那样拆分数据并进行筛选。

它还能进行站点配置：添加网站后获取跟踪代码片段，创建和编辑目标及漏斗，调整跟踪设置和站点过滤器。但无法更改或删除分析数据本身，且没有任何删除工具。

通过浏览器完成一次登录即可。无需粘贴内容、无需创建密钥、除服务器地址外无需其他配置。Statable不收集任何Cookie，无需分析服务同意横幅，数据托管在欧盟。

payload.name: AfAMax Property Calculations
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AfAMax provides free, non-binding calculations for German residential real estate. Estimate building depreciation (AfA), remaining useful life, annual and monthly depreciation, indicative tax effects, or allocate a purchase price between land and building using the German BMF methodology. Inputs are validated, tools are read-only and idempotent, and results include assumptions, limitations, attribution, and a disclaimer. Operated by Rundum Immo UG in Heidelberg, Germany. For informational planning only; not a substitute for tax, legal, or professional appraisal advice.
payload.longDescription: AfAMax为德国住宅房地产提供免费的非约束性计算服务。可估算建筑物折旧（AfA）、剩余使用寿命、年折旧和月折旧额、示意性税务影响，或根据德国联邦财政部（BMF）方法将购买价格在土地与建筑物间进行分配。输入数据经过验证，工具为只读且幂等，结果包含假设条件、使用限制、来源说明及免责声明。由德国海德堡Rundum Immo UG公司运营。仅用于信息规划目的，不可替代税务、法律或专业评估建议。

payload.name: GetMint
payload.description: 追踪您的品牌在AI答案中的表现
payload.summaryOriginal: Track your brand in AI answers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GetMint shows you how AI models talk about your brand. Ask about a domain or topic you track and get your visibility score against competitors, a share-of-voice leaderboard, how models describe your brand, and the exact sources they cite. Then act on it in the same conversation: research a content brief, edit the outline, and generate the article. Requires a GetMint account.
payload.longDescription: GetMint会向您展示AI模型如何谈论您的品牌。针对您关注的领域或主题进行提问，即可获取与竞争对手相比的可见性评分、语音份额排行榜、模型如何描述您的品牌，以及它们引用的具体来源。然后在同一场对话中采取行动：研究内容大纲、编辑提纲并生成文章。需要一个GetMint账户。

payload.name: Autelica
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Autelica is a sports video analysis app. It measures human movement from ordinary phone videos: how fast you ran, how far you went, your knee and hip angles and your left-right balance, with a 3D replay of the motion.

Attach a video of your sprint, jump, cut or swing and ask how fast you were. Autelica measures the whole motion, not a few frames: top speed, distance, knee and hip angles and left-right balance, with a 3D view you can orbit. One video gives an estimate, clearly labelled. Two to four videos of the same moment, filmed at the same time from different sides, give a measurement: Autelica lines up the clips, works out where each camera was from the athlete's own body and rebuilds every joint in 3D. While it processes, the card shows your place in the queue; when it's done, ChatGPT explains what the numbers mean and what to work on.

No video yet? Open an example: a real athlete filmed by three drones or three tripod cameras, rebuilt as a photoreal replay you can freeze and fly around, with its measured numbers. Or ask how to film: Autelica gives a setup for the number of phones you have.

Beat the sprint is a game built on the same motion: tap on each footstrike to race a real athlete's captured run, then send a friend a link to race your ghost.

Each result carries a grade that says how well the cameras agreed, and nothing about the athlete is generated. No account needed. Numbers are measurements from video with stated accuracy, not medical advice.
payload.longDescription:
Autelica是一款体育视频分析应用，可从普通手机视频中测量人体运动数据：您跑得多快、移动多远、膝盖和髋关节角度以及左右平衡情况，并提供动作的3D回放

上传您短跑、跳跃、变向或挥杆的视频并询问您的速度。Autelica会分析完整动作而非仅几帧画面：显示最高速度、距离、膝盖和髋关节角度以及左右平衡情况，并提供可旋转查看的3D视图。单个视频可提供明确标注的估算数据。使用2到4个同一时刻不同角度拍摄的视频，可获得精确测量结果：Autelica会同步视频片段，通过运动员自身身体定位计算各摄像机位置，并重建每个关节的3D模型。处理过程中卡片会显示您的排队位置；完成后ChatGPT将解释数据含义及需要改进的方向

还没有视频？可打开示例查看：真实运动员被三架无人机或三脚架摄像机拍摄的场景，以照片级真实的3D回放形式呈现，可暂停并自由视角浏览，同时显示测量数据。或询问拍摄建议：Autelica会根据您拥有的手机数量提供拍摄方案

超越短跑是一款基于相同运动分析技术的游戏：通过点击每次触地，与真实运动员的已记录跑动进行竞速，随后可向朋友发送链接进行虚拟对战

每个分析结果都带有评分，显示摄像机数据的一致性，且不会生成任何关于运动员的个人信息。无需账户即可使用。所有数据均为视频测量结果，标明了准确度，不构成医疗建议

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Measure your own videos attached in the chat: 1 video for an estimate, 2 to 4 for a 3D measurement, Top speed, distance, knee and hip angles and left-right balance from video, Photoreal 3D replays of real athletes you can freeze and fly around, Beat the sprint: a game where you race a real athlete's captured run and challenge friends, Filming guide for 1 to 4 phones

payload.name: Setlane
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Setlane helps you analyze strength-training history and manage your saved training data. Connect your account to review workouts and sets, saved routines, training summaries, exercise progress, personal records, and body-weight trends. Choose read-only access or explicitly allow read and write access during authorization. With read and write access, you can create and update workout templates and custom exercises, add or update today's body weight in your profile timezone, edit the date and exercise order of completed workouts, and edit existing completed-workout sets. Templates, completed workouts, and sets can be deleted after a preview and explicit confirmation. Active workouts cannot be changed. Creating workouts, adding sets, deleting custom exercises, and changing historical body-weight entries are not supported. Setlane accesses only data belonging to your connected account.
payload.longDescription:
Setlane可帮助您分析力量训练历史并管理保存的训练数据。
连接您的账户以查看锻炼记录、保存的训练计划、训练摘要、运动进展、个人最佳记录和体重趋势。
选择只读权限或在授权期间明确允许读写权限。
拥有读写权限后，您可以创建和更新锻炼模板和自定义训练项目，添加或更新个人资料中所在时区的当日体重，编辑已完成锻炼的日期和运动顺序，并编辑现有的已完成锻炼组数。
在预览并明确确认后，可删除模板、已完成的锻炼和组数。
活动中的锻炼无法更改。
不支持创建锻炼、添加组数、删除自定义训练项目或修改历史体重记录。
Setlane仅访问您连接账户的数据。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Training analytics, Manage workout templates, Manage custom exercises, Edit completed workouts and sets, Record body weight, Preview and confirm deletions

payload.name: ExplorationMaps
payload.description: 地图与矿产勘探权搜索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ExplorationMaps helps mineral exploration teams search public mineral-claim registries and create shareable claim, investor and infrastructure maps. Select a specific project by exact claim numbers, add company website branding and verified project facts, and show nearby claims separately on a chosen basemap with a locator inset and project callout.

Public registry searches and map previews require no account. Preview links are unlisted and expire after 30 days. Registry information is not a substitute for official title records, legal surveys or professional technical review.
payload.longDescription:
ExplorationMaps帮助矿产勘探团队搜索公共矿产勘探权登记册，并创建可共享的勘探权、投资者和基础设施地图。通过精确的勘探权编号选择特定项目，添加公司网站品牌标识和经验证的项目信息，并在选定的基础地图上以定位小图和项目标注形式单独展示周边勘探权。

公共登记册搜索和地图预览无需账户。预览链接为私有链接且30天后失效。登记信息不能替代官方产权记录、法律测绘或专业技术人员审核。

payload.name: Football Charts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Football Charts answers questions about football leagues with data: league tables, results with half-time scores, upcoming fixtures, when teams score and concede (goals by 15-minute period), team profiles, and Monte Carlo season projections (title, top-four and relegation chances). It covers 93 leagues in 42 countries, from the Premier League to lower divisions that few sources cover (Spain's Segunda RFEF groups, the Czech third tier, the English National League, Nordic, Baltic and Asian second tiers) plus women's top divisions. Data is updated daily.

Read-only; no account needed. Statistics and a baseline model only: no odds, no betting advice, no player-level data. Limitations: fixtures appear once they are within a few days of kick-off; historical seasons before the previous one need an API key from football-charts.com/developers.
payload.longDescription:
Football Charts通过数据回答关于足球联赛的问题：联赛积分榜、包含半场比分的比赛结果、即将进行的赛程、球队进球和失球时间分布（按15分钟时段统计）、球队资料，以及蒙特卡洛赛季预测（争冠、前四和降级概率）。
覆盖42个国家的93个联赛，从英超到其他少有报道的低级别联赛（如西班牙Segunda RFEF联赛组、捷克第三级别联赛、英格兰国家联赛、北欧/波罗的海及亚洲第二级别联赛）以及女子顶级联赛。
数据每日更新。

只读模式；无需账户。
仅提供统计数据和基础模型：不包含赔率、投注建议或球员层面数据。
使用限制：赛程仅在开赛前几天才会显示；需要访问前一个赛季的历史数据需从football-charts.com/developers获取API密钥。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: League tables, Results with half-time scores, Upcoming fixtures, Goal timing by period, Team profiles, Season projections, 93 leagues incl. lower divisions, Women's leagues

payload.name: Attri
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Site analytics, short links and SEO/AEO optimization for marketing teams.

Attri joins your Google Search Console data to what visitors do on your site, then ranks what to fix first by the visits each change could move: pages with a click-through gap, pages close to page one, pages competing for the same query, and sudden drops.

Ask what to fix this week, why a page lost traffic, or which campaigns and short links drive signups and bookings. Attri answers from your own workspace data and can plan findings or create tracked short links when you allow it.

Connect with your Attri account and choose which workspaces and permissions to share.
payload.longDescription:
为营销团队提供网站分析、短链接和SEO/AEO优化

Attri将您的Google Search Console数据与网站访问者行为关联，通过分析每项改动可能带来的流量变化，优先排序需要修复的问题：存在点击率缺口的页面、接近首页的页面、与相同搜索词竞争的页面，以及流量突然下降的页面

可询问本周需要修复的问题、页面流量下降的原因，或哪些活动和短链接带来了注册和预订
Attri会基于您的工作区数据进行回答，并在获得授权后可自动规划发现内容或创建跟踪短链接

连接您的Attri账户并选择需要共享的工作区及权限

payload.name: ASOScan App Store Optimization
payload.description: 应用商店排名与关键词
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ASOScan is an ASO skill and plugin for ChatGPT: App Store Optimization (ASO) software for iOS and Android apps, built and run by one app developer. Use ASO with ChatGPT: connect your ASOScan account and ask about your own apps in plain words.

What it does:
- App store ranking and Google Play store ASO. ASOScan reads your ASO score and its recommendations and tells you what to fix first, like an app store optimization checklist for your own listing.
- App keywords. App store keyword research with search volume and difficulty, keyword opportunities you could rank for, and tracking for the ones you pick.
- App store rank tracker. See where you rank for each tracked keyword and how the rank moved day by day, so you can see why your app is not showing in search.
- App store category ranking. See your app's chart position in its category over time.
- ASO audit. Check your app title and subtitle, keywords and description, see what changed over time, and draft listing text for other languages.
- App competitor analysis. Add a competitor by its store link and see the keywords it ranks for, its category rank and its rating history.
- App review analysis. See sentiment, top topics, bugs and feature requests, and get AI drafts of review replies. A reply goes to the store only after you approve the exact text, and only for apps connected to App Store Connect or Google Play Console.

Why teams use it: one set of app store optimization tools for the whole ASO job on both stores, with your real numbers right in the chat. Good ASO improves organic rankings, and ASOScan helps you rank better. It does not promise a rank.

What it does not do: it does not publish listing text to the stores, and it has no download or revenue data. Drafts stay in your ASOScan account.

You need an ASOScan account to see your own numbers. Without an account, the built-in skills still answer general ASO questions.
payload.longDescription:
ASOScan是专为ChatGPT设计的ASO技能插件：针对iOS和安卓应用的应用商店优化（ASO）软件，由单个应用开发者开发并运行。
通过ChatGPT使用ASO：连接您的ASOScan账户并用日常语言询问关于您自己的应用的问题。

主要功能：
- 应用商店排名与Google Play商店ASO。
ASOScan会读取您的ASO评分及其优化建议，并像应用商店优化检查清单一样告诉您优先需要修复的内容，针对您自己的应用信息展示。
- 应用关键词。
提供搜索量和难度的应用商店关键词研究，展示您可以优化的关键词机会，并追踪您选择的关键词。
- 应用商店排名追踪。
查看每个追踪关键词的排名情况及每日排名变化，从而了解您的应用为何未在搜索中显示。
- 应用商店分类排名。
查看您的应用在其分类中的排名趋势。
- ASO审计。
检查您的应用标题和副标题、关键词和描述，查看随时间的变化情况，并为其他语言撰写展示文案。
- 应用竞争对手分析。
通过商店链接添加竞争对手，查看其排名关键词、分类排名及评分历史。
- 应用评论分析。
查看情感倾向、核心话题、漏洞和功能请求，并获取评论回复的AI草稿。
回复内容需经您批准具体文本后才会提交至商店，且仅适用于连接了App Store Connect或Google Play Console的应用。

团队使用原因：一套适用于两个商店的完整ASO工具，您的真实数据直接呈现在聊天中。
良好的ASO能提升自然排名，ASOScan帮助您获得更好排名。
它不承诺保证具体排名。

无法实现的功能：无法向商店发布展示文案，且不提供下载量或收入数据。
草稿内容仅保存在您的ASOScan账户中。

您需要ASOScan账户才能查看自己的数据。
未注册账户时，内置功能仍可回答通用ASO问题。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read, Write, ASO score and recommendations, App store keyword research, Keyword opportunities, App store rank tracker, App store category ranking, Competitor keywords, Review insights, Review reply drafts, Localized listing drafts

payload.name: Autobound
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Autobound is a B2B data and analytics service for sales research: it searches and analyzes live buying signals to find companies and contacts to sell to, and shows why to reach out now.

Ask things like "Which fintech companies raised money in the last 30 days and are hiring sales leaders?" or "What changed at snowflake.com this month?" and get answers backed by fresh, sourced events, not guesses.

What's inside:
- 35 signal types and 900+ subtypes: news (funding, acquisitions, launches, leadership hires), job changes and promotions, hiring trends and velocity, SEC 8-K/10-K/10-Q filings, earnings calls, patents, federal contract awards, Product Hunt launches, podcasts, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube and more.
- Buyer intent on 37,000+ B2B topics, at the contact level (daily) and the company level (weekly).
- Company and contact lookups by domain, email or LinkedIn URL, with firmographics.
- Filters for industry, employee count, revenue, seniority, department and date.
- Email verification.

Every signal links to its source. Sign in with your Autobound account; there are no API keys to paste.
payload.longDescription:
Autobound是面向销售调研的B2B数据与分析服务：它会搜索并分析实时购买信号，以发现目标公司和联系人，并说明为何现在联系他们

您可以询问类似「哪些金融科技公司在过去30天内获得融资并正在招聘销售主管？」或「雪flake.com本月有哪些变化？」的问题，获取基于新鲜来源事件的可靠答案，而非猜测

包含内容：
- 35种信号类型和900多个子类型：新闻（融资、收购、发布、领导层招聘）、职位变动与晋升、招聘趋势与速度、SEC 8-K/10-K/10-Q文件、财报电话会议、专利、联邦合同授予、Product Hunt发布、播客、领英、Reddit、YouTube等
- 37,000多个B2B主题的买家意图，支持联系人层级（每日）和公司层级（每周）
- 通过域名、邮箱或领英网址查询公司和联系人信息，包含企业属性数据
- 行业、员工数量、营收、职级、部门和日期等筛选条件
- 邮箱验证

每个信号都链接到其来源。
使用您的Autobound账户登录；无需粘贴API密钥。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search companies and contacts by buying signals, Look up a company's or contact's recent signals, Find companies and contacts showing buyer intent, Export buyer-intent lists, Verify email deliverability

payload.name: GrowByData Compass
payload.description: SEO 与 AI 搜索洞察
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GrowByData Compass helps teams track share of voice, search rankings, and visibility across both traditional search engines and AI search platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, and Perplexity.
Common tasks include monitoring keyword rankings and position history over time, comparing share of voice against competitors, and identifying keyword gaps where competitors rank but a domain doesn't. Users also track how their brand is mentioned and cited within AI-generated search answers, including sentiment, and analyze SERP feature ownership such as featured snippets and above-the-fold placements. On the advertising side, it supports monitoring competitor text ads, shopping ads, and ad placements within AI search results.
Example prompts a user might type:
 "How is our domain ranking for our top 20 keywords this month?"
 "Show me our share of voice versus our top 3 competitors over the last quarter."
 "Are we being mentioned in ChatGPT or AI Overviews for our category, and what's the sentiment?"
 "What keywords are our competitors ranking for that we're missing?"
payload.longDescription:
GrowByData Compass 帮助团队跟踪传统搜索引擎及 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode、AI Overviews、Perplexity 等 AI 搜索平台上的声量份额、搜索排名和可见度。
常见任务包括监测关键词排名和历史排名变化、比较与竞争对手的声量份额，以及发现竞争对手已有排名而某个域名尚未覆盖的关键词。用户还可以跟踪自己的品牌在 AI 生成的搜索回答中被提及和引用的情况，包括情感倾向，并分析精选摘要、首屏展示位置等搜索结果页（SERP）功能由哪些网站占据。在广告方面，支持监测竞争对手的文字广告、购物广告以及 AI 搜索结果中的广告展示位置。
用户可能输入的示例提示：
“本月我们的域名在最重要的 20 个关键词上的排名如何？”
“展示上个季度我们的声量份额与前 3 名竞争对手的比较。”
“ChatGPT 或 AI Overviews 在我们的行业类别中是否提及我们，情感倾向如何？”
“哪些关键词是竞争对手已有排名而我们尚未覆盖的？”

payload.name: MAIA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MAIA is the geospatial research engine for questions about places in the United States, in any field. Ask in plain language and MAIA's agent researches it and builds the answer as a project with a map and a table: which places or properties match your criteria, who owns them, what is near them, how many there are in an area, or a list of them with contacts or other details MAIA researches for each row. Data can include parcels, owners, zoning, buildings, contacts, businesses and points of interest, schools, roads and land use, and MAIA's agent can find and add suitable public map layers. Through this plugin you can start a project for a county, send follow-up requests, answer MAIA's questions and approve larger steps during a run, check progress, review your projects' layers and views, and save notes and reusable skills that MAIA uses in later projects. Each answer links to the full map and table in MAIA.
payload.longDescription: MAIA是针对美国各地的各类问题进行地理空间研究的引擎。以自然语言提问，MAIA的智能体将进行研究，并构建包含地图和表格的项目作为答案：哪些地点或物业符合您的标准，它们的业主是谁，周边有什么设施，某个区域有多少个这样的地点，或包含联系人或其他详细信息的列表，MAIA会为每一项进行研究。数据可包含地块、业主、用地规划、建筑、联系人、企业及兴趣点、学校、道路和土地利用信息，MAIA的智能体可查找并添加合适的公开地图图层。通过此插件您可以为某个县启动项目，发送后续请求，回答MAIA的问题并在运行过程中批准更大步骤，查看进度，回顾项目中的图层和视图，并保存笔记及可在后续项目中重复使用的技能。每个答案都会链接到MAIA中的完整地图和表格。

payload.name: Ciro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ciro is a sell-out analytics platform for consumer brands that sell through retail chains. It brings together the sales and stock data each chain shares with its suppliers, links the chain's product and store codes to the brand's own catalog, and keeps that data current.

Ciro for ChatGPT answers questions with that data for the Ciro organization you connect:
- Sales and units by retail chain, banner, brand, category, product, store, region or time, including comparisons with last year or last month.
- Stock, out-of-stocks and stock coverage by product and store.
- Purchase suggestions to reach your target days of inventory.
- Your saved Ciro dashboards, over their own date range or another one.
- Data freshness: the last day with sales and the last stock report for each chain, and the state of each integration.

It's read-only: it can't change data, settings or users in Ciro. You approve each connection for one Ciro organization, and your access is checked again on every request.

Ciro is built for key account managers, sales teams and demand planners at consumer brands, mainly in Latin America. You need a Ciro account with access to an organization. Answers reflect the retail chains your organization has connected, and data usually arrives one day late.
payload.longDescription:
Ciro是面向通过零售连锁店销售的消费品牌提供的销售分析平台。它整合各连锁店向供应商提供的销售和库存数据，将连锁店的产品和门店编码与品牌自身的商品目录关联，并保持数据的实时更新。

Ciro for ChatGPT可针对您连接的Ciro组织数据进行问答：
- 按零售连锁店、品牌、品类、产品、门店、区域或时间维度统计的销售数据和销量，包含同比或环比对比数据。
- 按产品和门店统计的库存情况、缺货情况及库存覆盖率。
- 为达成目标库存天数提供的采购建议。
- 您保存的Ciro仪表盘数据，支持自定义时间范围查询。
- 数据时效性：各连锁店最新销售日期及最新库存报告日期，以及各数据源的连接状态。

Ciro for ChatGPT为只读模式：它无法在Ciro中更改数据、设置或用户。您需为每个Ciro组织单独审批连接，且每次请求时都会重新验证您的访问权限。

Ciro主要面向消费品牌方的客户经理、销售团队和需求计划人员，尤其服务于拉丁美洲市场。您需要拥有可访问组织的Ciro账号。回答内容基于您组织已连接的零售连锁店数据，数据通常会有1天的延迟。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Sales and units by chain, brand, product, store or time, Stock and out-of-stock analysis, Purchase suggestions to reach target days of inventory, Saved Ciro dashboards, Data freshness for each retail chain

payload.name: Fit File Forge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fit File Forge connects ChatGPT to your endurance training. Ask how a session went and get a detailed analysis from your real data: pacing and splits, heart rate and power, climbing, time in zones and a chart of the whole session. Ask whether your fitness is building, how fatigued you are, or what time is realistic for your next 5K, half or marathon. Describe a workout in plain words ("6 × 800 m at 5K pace on Thursday") and Fit File Forge builds a valid structured Garmin workout, shows it, and sends it to your watch only when you ask.

For runners, cyclists, swimmers and triathletes who train with a Garmin watch and use Fit File Forge (fitfileforge.com). You sign in with your Fit File Forge account; activity data needs Garmin Connect linked in Fit File Forge with activity sharing on.

What it never shares: GPS locations or routes, original activity files, or health data such as sleep or HRV (Fit File Forge doesn't collect it). You choose what ChatGPT may see and do when you connect, and you can disconnect at any time. Training information only, not medical advice.
payload.longDescription:
Fit File Forge将ChatGPT与您的耐力训练连接。询问课程表现即可获得基于真实数据的详细分析：配速与分段、心率与功率、爬升、各强度区间时间及完整课程图表。询问体能提升情况、疲劳程度或下一次5公里/半马/全马的合理用时。用自然语言描述训练内容（如「周四以5公里配速完成6组800米」），Fit File Forge将生成有效结构化的Garmin训练计划，仅在您要求时展示并发送至手表

面向使用Garmin手表并启用Fit File Forge（fitfileforge.com）的跑者、骑行者、游泳者及铁人三项运动员。您需使用Fit File Forge账户登录；活动数据需在Fit File Forge中关联Garmin Connect并开启活动共享

该工具不会共享：GPS位置或路线、原始活动文件、健康数据（如睡眠或HRV）（Fit File Forge本身不收集此类信息）。您可自主设定ChatGPT在连接时的可见范围与操作权限，且可随时断开连接。仅提供训练信息，不提供医疗建议

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Analyse a training session in detail, Track fitness, fatigue and training load, Predict race times and best efforts, Show your training calendar, Build structured workouts from plain language, Send workouts to your Garmin watch when you ask

payload.name: Orgvue US
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Orgvue is the organizational design and workforce planning platform used by enterprises to model, cost and reshape their organizations. Connect OpenAI to Orgvue to explore workforce data, organizational structures, and planning scenarios.

In plain, natural language, ask questions about your workforce data: spans and layers, headcount by function, cost of a proposed structure, the gap between your current and future-state organization, or anything else you might want to know.

Ask workforce modelling questions and see the changes happening directly in Orgvue. You’ll get trusted answers grounded in your Orgvue data. See the impact of a scenario before you commit, draft the narrative for a restructure paper, or quickly pull the numbers you need for a board meeting.

Access follows your existing Orgvue permissions. OpenAI sees only the workspaces and datasets you're already entitled to, and only when you ask.

Orgvue remains the trusted source of workforce data and organizational scenarios, while OpenAI provides a conversational way to interact with them.

What you can do:
- Query datasets and properties across your Orgvue workspaces
- Summarize org structures - reporting lines, spans, layers, vacancies
- Ask the agent workforce modelling questions and instantly visualise the impact of changes in Orgvue
- Pull metrics and aggregations for reports, papers and presentations
- Explain what a dataset contains before you dig into it
payload.longDescription:
Orgvue是企业用于组织设计和人力资源规划的平台，可对企业组织进行建模、成本核算和重塑。将OpenAI连接到Orgvue，以探索人力资源数据、组织结构和规划场景。

用简单自然的中文提问您的组织数据：管理幅度和层级、按职能统计的人数、拟议架构的成本、当前组织与未来组织的差距，或您可能想了解的任何其他内容。

提出人力资源建模问题并直接在Orgvue中查看变化。您将获得基于Orgvue数据的可信答案。在承诺前查看方案影响，起草重组方案文档，或快速获取董事会会议所需的数字。

访问权限遵循您现有的Orgvue权限设置。OpenAI仅能看到您有权访问的工作区和数据集，且仅在您主动查询时可见。

Orgvue仍是人力资源数据和组织场景的权威来源，而OpenAI提供了一种对话式交互方式。

您可以执行以下操作：
- 跨Orgvue工作区查询数据集和属性
- 总结组织结构（汇报关系、管理幅度、层级、空缺）
- 向智能体提出人力资源建模问题并即时在Orgvue中可视化变化影响
- 提取指标和汇总数据用于报告、方案和演示
- 在深入分析前了解数据集内容

payload.name: Fospha (North & South America)
payload.description: 通过数据提问、解答并采取行动。
payload.summaryOriginal: Ask, answer, act on your data.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Fospha's daily, full-funnel measurement into ChatGPT, so you can use natural language to understand the impact of every channel across everywhere you sell without dashboards or manual reports.
payload.longDescription: 将Fospha的每日全漏斗测量数据接入ChatGPT，即可通过自然语言了解所有销售渠道的影响，而无需仪表板或手动报告。

payload.name: DataForSEO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DataForSEO MCP server is a useful solution for on-demand SEO automation. Fetch SEO and marketing data from DataForSEO APIs without leaving chat; look up keyword search volume, ranking difficulty scores, and related keyword ideas; pull live Google SERP results for any query; review backlinks, referring domains, competitor profiles, and more.
payload.longDescription: DataForSEO MCP服务器是按需SEO自动化的实用解决方案。无需离开聊天界面，即可通过DataForSEO API获取SEO和营销数据；查询关键词搜索量、排名难度评分及相关关键词建议；获取任意搜索词的实时谷歌SERP结果；查看反向链接、引用域名、竞争对手资料等信息。

payload.name: Jsonify
payload.description: 可靠的网络数据，重复使用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tell ChatGPT what data you need. Jsonify builds a pipeline to collect it, check it and keep it up to date.

Track competitor prices, restaurant menus, property listings, job openings or news across your chosen sources. Collect once or on a schedule, with structured results you can query, compare and export. When a source changes, Jsonify can diagnose and repair the pipeline.

Work with your data right inside ChatGPT. Ask questions, explore datasets and dashboards, inspect where results came from, or describe what you want to collect next. Your pipelines keep running between conversations.

Requires a Jsonify account. Your plan’s usage limits apply.
payload.longDescription:
告诉ChatGPT你需要哪些数据。
Jsonify会构建数据管道来收集、验证并保持数据更新。

跟踪你选定来源中的竞争对手价格、餐厅菜单、房产列表、职位空缺或新闻。
可一次性收集或按计划收集，获取可查询、比较和导出的结构化结果。
当数据源发生变化时，Jsonify可诊断并修复数据管道。

在ChatGPT内部直接处理你的数据。
提出问题、探索数据集和仪表盘、检查结果来源，或描述你想要收集的下一项内容。
你的数据管道在对话间持续运行。

需要Jsonify账户。
适用你的计划使用限制。

payload.name: Korzaro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore your Korzaro shop results in ChatGPT: sales, marketing, open findings, published briefings, SEO, mailing, reviews, competitors, social media and customer cohorts. Korzaro returns aggregate summaries for the one project and data areas approved by its owner. It cannot change the shop, campaigns or data.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中探索您的Korzaro店铺成果：销售数据、市场推广、未解决发现、已发布简报、SEO优化、邮件营销、用户评价、竞品分析、社交媒体及客户群体分析。
Korzaro仅返回经所有者授权的项目及数据区域的综合摘要。
该工具无法对店铺运营、营销活动或数据内容进行修改。

payload.name: BLS OEWS by 1102tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Independent, unofficial app developed by James Jenrette / 1102tools using public Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) data. Not affiliated with or endorsed by BLS or the U.S. government.

Look up occupational wages nationally, by state, or by metro; compare wages across locations and occupations; and calculate wage benchmarks with user-selected burden multipliers. Eight read-only tools use the bundled May 2025 OEWS release, published May 15, 2026. No account or API key is required. Base wages exclude fringe, overhead, and profit; burdened rates are estimates. Historical releases and forecasts are not available. BLS.gov cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from BLS.gov.
payload.longDescription:
由James Jenrette/1102tools开发的独立非官方应用，使用公开的美国劳工统计局职业就业与工资统计（OEWS）数据。与BLS或美国政府无关联，也未获得其认可或推荐。

可在全国、各州或都会区范围内查询职业工资数据；跨地区和职业对比工资水平；通过用户自选的负担倍数计算工资基准值。八个只读工具使用捆绑的2025年5月版OEWS发布数据，该数据于2026年5月15日发布。无需账户或API密钥。基础工资不包含福利、管理费用和利润；负担后费率仅为估算值。不提供历史版本和预测数据。BLS.gov无法对从其网站获取数据后产生的任何数据或分析结果负责。

payload.name: Intuizi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Intuizi connects ChatGPT to the Intuizi data platform, where marketing teams turn de-identified signal data into audiences and deliver them to their marketing destinations. The plugin queries the Large Behavioral Model, Intuizi's flagship LQM, trained on de-identified, real-world behavioral signal. Responses include counts, statuses, and metadata. Audience data never enters the chat and is sent only to destinations configured in the Intuizi console.

What you can do:
- Look up reference catalogs: POI categories and brands, apps, web domains, CTV channels, Transactions merchants, demographic and profile attributes, countries, and signal providers.
- Estimate how large an audience would be before you build it, then create audiences from POI visits, app usage, web domains, CTV viewing, Transactions, demographics, profile attributes, home location, or your own cohorts, alone or combined with AND, OR, and NOT IN.
- Grow a completed audience with a lookalike model and follow the model run.
- Preview a frequency range, then activate the audience to a delivery destination your team has already set up in the Intuizi console.
- Create cohorts from your own files or from an existing audience, and manage projects, POI categories, brands, and location submissions.
- Check your organization's data-scan usage against its limits.

Every tool wraps a documented Intuizi API v2 endpoint, so validation, permissions, and rate limits match the API exactly. Read-only tools are marked read-only and delete tools are marked destructive. You need an Intuizi console account: connect with one-click OAuth, approve access in your browser, and the plugin sees only the projects and data your account can see.
payload.longDescription:
Intuizi将ChatGPT连接到Intuizi数据平台，营销团队可在此将去标识化的信号数据转化为受众群体，并将其传递到营销目的地。该插件会查询大型行为模型Intuizi的旗舰LQM，该模型基于去标识化的现实世界行为信号进行训练。响应内容包括数量、状态和元数据。受众数据不会进入聊天对话，仅会发送到Intuizi控制台中配置的目的地。

您可以：
- 查询参考目录：兴趣点类别和品牌、应用、网站域名、联网电视频道、交易商户、人口统计和资料属性、国家以及信号供应商。
- 在构建受众前预估规模，然后通过兴趣点访问、应用使用、网站域名、联网电视观看、交易、人口统计、资料属性、常住地或您自己的群体，单独或结合使用AND、OR、NOT IN逻辑创建受众。
- 通过相似受众模型扩展已完成的受众群体并跟踪模型运行。
- 预览频率范围，然后将受众激活到团队已在Intuizi控制台设置的交付目的地。
- 从自有文件或现有受众创建群体，并管理项目、兴趣点类别、品牌和地点提交。
- 检查组织的数据扫描使用情况与配额限制的对比。

每个工具都封装了经过文档说明的Intuizi API v2端点，因此验证、权限和速率限制与API完全一致。只读工具标记为只读，删除工具标记为破坏性操作。您需要Intuizi控制台账户：通过一键式OAuth连接，在浏览器中批准访问权限，插件仅能查看账户有权访问的项目和数据。

payload.name: GSA Per Diem by 1102tools
payload.description: 查找联邦每日补贴标准
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Independent, unofficial app developed by James Jenrette / 1102tools using public GSA per diem data. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by GSA or the U.S. government.

Look up CONUS lodging and meals-and-incidental-expenses rates by city, ZIP code, or state; see seasonal lodging and M&IE breakdowns; and estimate or compare travel per diem. Seven read-only tools provide source-backed rates and calculations. No user sign-in or API key is needed. Estimates exclude airfare and ground transportation. Verify the fiscal year, month, and work locality before using a rate.
payload.longDescription:
由James Jenrette/1102tools开发的独立非官方应用，使用公开的GSA每日补贴数据
与GSA或美国政府无关联，也未获得其认可

可通过城市、邮政编码或州份查询CONUS住宿及餐饮与杂费标准，查看季节性住宿和餐饮费用细分，并估算或对比差旅每日补贴
七项只读工具提供基于来源的费率和计算
无需用户登录或API密钥
估算不包括机票和地面交通费用
使用费率前请确认财年、月份和工作地点

payload.name: CallRail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give ChatGPT access to your CallRail account, to analyze interaction data, manage your data and configuration, and know what marketing is working for you.
payload.longDescription: 让ChatGPT访问您的CallRail账户，以分析交互数据、管理您的数据和配置，并了解哪些营销策略对您有效。

payload.name: Voris - Human & AI Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Grok are already answering with your brand. Voris tracks those citations, measures the awareness they build, and reports what they earn you in plain language. Cookieless, EU hosted, live.
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude和Grok已开始以您的品牌身份进行回答。
Voris会追踪这些引用内容，评估其带来的品牌认知度，并用通俗易懂的语言报告其为您带来的收益。
无Cookie追踪，欧盟本地托管，实时运行。

payload.name: Ask the Grid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask the Grid connects ChatGPT to live and historical US electricity-grid data. Check current grid conditions, find and query published market datasets, read Energy Wire briefings, explore grid assets, and manage your own alerts and saved grid assets. Results retain source, timestamp, market, and unit context.
payload.longDescription: Ask the Grid 将 ChatGPT 与实时及历史美国电力电网数据相连接。查看当前电网状况、查找并查询已发布的市场数据集、阅读 Energy Wire 简报、探索电网资产，并管理自己的警报与保存的电网资产。结果会保留来源、时间戳、市场及单位上下文信息。

payload.name: imotesa.bg
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: imotesa.bg is an independent instrument for inspecting Bulgarian properties, their observed asking-price history, and local market context. It creates canonical links for requested property filters. Prices are observed asking prices, not transaction prices.
payload.longDescription: imotesa.bg 是一个独立工具，用于检查保加利亚房产、其观察到的要价历史及当地市场背景。它为请求的房产过滤器生成规范链接。价格为观察到的要价，而非交易价格。

payload.name: Chartrades Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chartrades is a market data and research service. Connect your Chartrades account to view reports, check price and volume history, and see when data is stale or incomplete.
payload.longDescription: Chartrades 是市场数据和研究服务。连接您的 Chartrades 账户以查看报告、查看价格和成交量历史，并查看数据是否过时或不完整。

payload.name: ProfitHero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other trades business context into ChatGPT with ProfitHero. Pull goals, live KPIs, and weekly insights so answers, trends, and next moves are grounded in your actual ServiceTitan, HouseCall Pro, and QuickBooks data.
payload.longDescription: 通过ProfitHero将您的暖通空调、管道、电气及其他行业业务背景带入ChatGPT。拉取目标、实时KPI和周度洞察，使答案、趋势和下一步行动均基于您实际的ServiceTitan、HouseCall Pro和QuickBooks数据。

payload.name: HailPing
payload.description: 查找近期美国冰雹风暴
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HailPing lets you search its published hail storm reports for the continental United States. Find reports by state, city, date range, reported hail size, or distance from a US city or coordinates. Each result gives the storm date, largest reported hailstone, number of qualifying reports, and a link to the public report. You can open a report for its summary, affected cities and counties, and hail size distribution, or view a city market page with its recorded hail history and frequency band. The catalog covers published events from 2025 onward using Vaisala Xweather reports. Reported hail and modeled storm footprints do not confirm property damage, and this is not a forecast or warning service.
payload.longDescription: HailPing允许您搜索其发布的美国本土冰雹风暴报告，可通过州、城市、日期范围、报告的冰雹大小，或距离美国城市及坐标的距离进行查询。每个结果包括风暴日期、最大报告冰雹石、合格报告数量以及公共报告链接。您可以打开报告查看摘要、受影响城市及县区、冰雹大小分布，或查看包含记录冰雹历史和频段的城市市场页面。该目录涵盖2025年及以后的Vaisala Xweather报告事件。报告的冰雹数据和模拟风暴范围不用于确认财产损失，本服务非天气预测或预警系统。

payload.name: TalkToData Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore the Google Analytics 4 property you selected in TalkToData through five read-only tools. Ask about traffic, acquisition sources, pages, devices, and a seven-day summary. The plugin fetches authorized data on demand and cannot modify your Analytics property.
payload.longDescription: 通过五个只读工具探索在TalkToData中选择的Google Analytics 4属性。可询问流量、获取来源、页面、设备和七天摘要。该插件按需获取授权数据，无法修改您的分析属性。

payload.name: EnergyIA.AR
payload.description: 阿根廷能源与矿业数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
EnergyIA.AR connects ChatGPT to official Argentine data on energy and mining, normalized and kept up to date from government and market sources.

What you can ask:
- Oil and gas: production by field, basin, formation, province, operator and well, with rankings, year-over-year changes and history since 2006.
- Who leads each sector: top operators, who is rising and falling, and side-by-side company comparisons.
- Mining: projects, production and exports by mineral and province.
- Electricity: installed capacity by technology and province, generation, demand and large industrial consumers.
- Gas network, gas consumption, the oil value chain and fuel prices at the pump.
- Energy trade: exports by port and destination, and export prices by company.
- RIGI large-investment projects, public tenders and opportunities for suppliers.
- Macro context: consumer prices and the exchange rate.

Every answer carries its source, its period and its unit, and states how far each dataset reaches. All tools are read-only. Coverage is Argentina only. Works in Spanish and English. Requires an EnergyIA.AR account.
payload.longDescription:
EnergyIA.AR将ChatGPT连接至官方阿根廷能源与矿业数据，数据来自政府和市场来源，经过标准化处理并保持实时更新。

您可以查询：
- 石油和天然气：按区块、盆地、地层、省份、运营商和井的产量，包含排名、同比变化及自2006年以来的历史数据。
- 各领域主导者：顶级运营商、正在崛起与下滑的企业，以及企业间的对比分析。
- 矿业：按矿物和省份划分的项目、产量及出口情况。
- 电力：按技术和省份划分的装机容量、发电量、需求及大型工业用户。
- 天然气管网、天然气消费、石油价值链及加油站油价。
- 能源贸易：按港口和目的地的出口情况，以及按公司划分的出口价格。
- RIGI大型投资项目、公共招标及供应商机会。
- 宏观背景：消费者价格及汇率。

每个回答都会标注来源、时间范围和单位，并说明每个数据集的覆盖范围。
所有工具均为只读模式。
仅覆盖阿根廷地区。
支持西班牙语和英语。
需要EnergyIA.AR账户。

payload.name: Tap by P3 Adaptive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tap by P3 Adaptive answers questions from Power BI models that P3 Adaptive has made public. It lists the public models and what each one holds, reads a model's tables, columns, measures and relationships, and runs one read-only DAX query at a time against the live model through the Power BI executeQueries REST API, so every figure is current when you ask. Each answer names the model it came from. Nobody signs in. The question, the query and its results are not kept, and the caller's address is kept only as a keyed code that changes daily, used for rate limits. Tap is a pilot, so its models and limits can change.
payload.longDescription: Tap by P3 Adaptive可解答P3 Adaptive公开的Power BI模型相关问题。它列出了公开的模型及其内容，可读取模型的表格、列、度量值和关系，并通过Power BI executeQueries REST API对实时模型执行单个只读DAX查询，确保您提问时数据始终为最新状态。每个回答都会标注数据来源模型。无需登录即可使用。问题、查询及结果不会被保存，调用方地址仅以每日更新的密钥代码形式临时存储，用于限速管控。Tap目前处于试点阶段，其模型和使用限制可能随时调整。

payload.name: Adzviser Klaviyo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Klaviyo email and SMS data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to see how your campaigns and flows are performing and what they are earning.

Compare opens, clicks, unsubscribes, conversions, and attributed revenue across date ranges. Break results down by campaign, flow, message, or list. Turn your marketing data into clear reports, spot trends, and see which sends are actually driving revenue.
payload.longDescription:
通过Adzviser将您的Klaviyo电子邮件和短信数据连接到ChatGPT。用自然语言提问，查看您的活动和流程的表现以及它们带来的收益。

在不同日期范围内比较打开率、点击率、退订率、转化率和归因收入。按活动、流程、消息或列表分解结果。将您的营销数据转化为清晰的报告，发现趋势，并查看哪些发送真正带来了收入。

payload.name: Charts by Szum
payload.description: 将数据转化为精美的图表
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Charts by Szum helps ChatGPT turn plain-language requests and raw data into polished charts. Explore curated themes and examples, validate chart definitions, and display interactive previews with SVG and PNG image links. Save results for permanent image and interactive embed links, then reopen, update, rename, or delete charts from ChatGPT or Szum Studio. Useful for reports, presentations, product work, and dashboards.
payload.longDescription: Charts by Szum帮助ChatGPT将自然语言请求和原始数据转化为精美图表。探索精选主题和示例，验证图表定义，并通过SVG和PNG图像链接显示交互式预览。保存结果以获取永久图像和交互式嵌入链接，然后从ChatGPT或Szum Studio重新打开、更新、重命名或删除图表。适用于报告、演示文稿、产品工作和仪表板。

payload.name: RaceCharts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create and edit animated bar, line and pie charts from ChatGPT using your RaceCharts account. Start with your own data, an existing project or a ready-made example. Customize titles, colors, layouts, images, music and timeline events.
With direct saving enabled, your assistant saves your requested changes and gives you a project link. You can also preview changes before saving. You control which projects and actions your assistant can access.
When your chart is ready, ask for a video and receive a download link. Exports use your existing RaceCharts plan or export credits. A RaceCharts account is required.
payload.longDescription: 通过您的RaceCharts账户，从ChatGPT创建并编辑动态条形图、折线图和饼图。从您自己的数据、现有项目或现成示例开始。自定义标题、颜色、布局、图片、音乐和时间轴事件。启用直接保存功能后，您的助手会保存您请求的更改并提供项目链接。您也可以在保存前预览更改。您可以控制助手可访问的项目和操作。当图表准备就绪时，请求生成视频并接收下载链接。导出功能将使用您现有的RaceCharts计划或导出积分。需要RaceCharts账户。

payload.name: Supaflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and run data pipelines directly in ChatGPT. Move data across SaaS apps, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes. Transform data using dbt Core™ models and sync data to your business apps with reverse ETL. Orchestrate pipelines, manage schedules, and troubleshoot issues—all through conversation.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中直接构建和运行数据管道。
在SaaS应用、数据库、数据仓库和数据湖之间移动数据。
通过dbt Core™模型转换数据，并利用反向ETL将数据同步到您的业务应用中。
通过对话编排数据管道、管理调度任务并排查问题。

payload.name: Adzviser CallRail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your CallRail call tracking data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to see how many calls your marketing is generating and where those calls come from.

Compare total calls, first-time callers, answered and missed calls, and call duration across date ranges. Break results down by tracking number, source, campaign, or agent. Turn your call data into clear reports and see which channels are actually driving the phone to ring.
payload.longDescription:
通过Adzviser将您的CallRail通话跟踪数据连接至ChatGPT。用自然语言提问即可查看营销活动带来的通话量及来电来源

跨日期范围对比总通话量、首次来电者、已接听/未接听电话及通话时长。按跟踪号码、来源、活动或代理拆分数据。将通话数据转化为清晰报告，查看哪些渠道真正带来电话

payload.name: NetAPI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Registered domain data from netapi.com for 1,584 TLDs, DNS providers and registrars. Free, no plan needed: compromised domain and IP checks, search in newly registered domains by word, the most popular websites of a country, TLD, registrar and DNS-provider statistics, and the popularity rank of a domain in the NetAPI Top 1M. 
With a NetAPI plan: download links for the full list of a zone, the domains registered or deleted in the last 24 hours, all zones at once, or all domains of a DNS provider or a registrar; lists hold domain names (any plan), datasets add nameservers, hosting IP and country, emails and phone numbers to every domain (Plus or Pro).  Also domain and IP lookups.
payload.longDescription:
来自netapi.com的注册域名数据，涵盖1,584个顶级域名、DNS服务商和注册商。
免费使用无需计划：可进行受感染域名和IP检查，通过关键词搜索新注册域名，查看某国家最热门网站、顶级域名、注册商和DNS服务商统计信息，以及NetAPI前100万域名的热度排名。
订阅NetAPI计划后：可下载区域完整列表的下载链接，获取过去24小时内注册或删除的域名、一次性下载所有区域，或所有DNS服务商/注册商的域名列表；所有计划均包含域名名称，Plus或Pro计划的数据集会为每个域名添加名称服务器、托管IP和国家信息、电子邮件和电话号码。
还提供域名和IP查询功能。

payload.name: MerchantSpring
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MerchantSpring is the marketplace analytics platform built for agencies and enterprise brands, unifying sales, profit, advertising, inventory, traffic, Buy Box, and customer performance across seller and vendor accounts on 120+ marketplaces including Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and more.

ChatGPT pulls live, portfolio-wide metrics with period-on-period comparisons built in. Drill from the total portfolio down to a single store or SKU, covering sales trends, store and product-level profit and loss, advertising performance by channel, and on-demand report types spanning inventory health, Buy Box performance, traffic and conversion, customer lifetime value, refunds, repeat purchase and more.

Ask things like "Compare sales across all client marketplaces this month vs last", "Which SKUs ran negative margins last quarter?", "How did advertising performance shift across channels week on week?", or "Show ordered vs shipped revenue for our Amazon Vendor accounts by month". ChatGPT fetches the live numbers and does the analysis on the spot.

For agencies, that means the whole client book in one conversation - filter any query by marketplace, country, or store tags, compare performance across every account you manage, and turn the answers straight into client-ready reporting. Seller and vendor accounts are both fully supported.

Trusted by 35,000+ brands and agencies.
payload.longDescription:
MerchantSpring是专为代理商和企业品牌打造的市场分析平台，整合了亚马逊、沃尔玛、eBay、Shopify等120+个市场的销售、利润、广告、库存、流量、Buy Box及客户表现数据，覆盖卖家和供应商账户

ChatGPT可提取实时的全 portfolio 数据并内置逐期对比功能。可从整体投资组合逐层深入到单个店铺或SKU，涵盖销售趋势、店铺及产品级盈亏、分渠道广告表现，以及库存健康度、Buy Box表现、流量转化、客户终身价值、退款、复购率等按需报告类型

可提问如「比较本月与上月所有客户市场的销售额」「上季度哪些SKU出现负毛利」「每周各渠道广告表现如何变化」「展示我们Amazon供应商账户按月统计的订单与发货收入」等。ChatGPT会实时获取数据并即时完成分析

对代理商而言，可在单次对话中管理全部客户资料——通过市场、国家或店铺标签筛选任意查询，对比所管理账户的全部表现，并直接生成客户报告。卖家和供应商账户均得到全面支持

被35,000+个品牌和代理商信赖。

payload.name: Lemonado
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Analyze your connected marketing data.

Ask questions about marketing data connected to Lemonado, compare performance across periods, and explore results in charts and tables. Uses the projects and accounts available through your Lemonado connection.
payload.longDescription:
分析您连接的营销数据。

您可以向Lemonado查询连接的营销数据，跨周期比较表现，并在图表和表格中探索结果。使用通过您的Lemonado连接可用的项目和账户。

payload.name: Outlook Email
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Microsoft Outlook email for work conversations: search messages, summarize threads, draft replies, manage follow-ups.
payload.longDescription: 用于工作沟通的 Microsoft Outlook 邮件：搜索邮件、总结对话串、起草回复并管理后续跟进。

payload.name: Slack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up chats and messages
payload.longDescription: 查找聊天和消息

payload.name: Superhuman Mail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Superhuman Mail to build powerful workflows across Gmail, Outlook, and Google Calendar. Search your inbox and calendar, summarize what matters, draft AI replies in your voice, check read statuses, prepare for your day, send emails or schedule events, and manage multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Superhuman Mail，在 Gmail、Outlook 和 Google Calendar 之间构建强大的工作流程。搜索收件箱和日历、总结重要内容、以你的口吻拟写 AI 回复、查看已读状态、为一天的安排做准备、发送邮件或安排活动，并管理多个 Gmail 和 Outlook 账户。

payload.name: Teams
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Microsoft Teams workplace chat and collaboration: search messages, summarize threads, send replies, manage Planner tasks.
payload.longDescription: Microsoft Teams 办公聊天与协作：搜索消息、总结讨论串、发送回复并管理 Planner 任务。

payload.name: Hostinger Mail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hostinger Mail helps users discover mailbox operations, inspect mailboxes and folders, read or search messages, send email, and manage message or webhook state in their authenticated Hostinger Mail account through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT，用户可以在经过身份验证的 Hostinger Mail 账号中查找邮箱操作、检查邮箱和文件夹、阅读或搜索邮件、发送电子邮件，以及管理邮件或 webhook 状态。

payload.name: Zoom
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zoom connects Codex to Zoom meeting context through the Zoom app connector and provides developer workflows for planning, building, debugging, and reviewing Zoom integrations across APIs, SDKs, webhooks, WebSockets, bots, and automation use cases.
payload.longDescription: Zoom 通过 Zoom 应用连接器将 Zoom 会议背景连接到 Codex，并为规划、构建、调试和审核 Zoom 集成提供开发工作流，涵盖 API、SDK、webhook、WebSocket、机器人和自动化场景。

payload.name: Mailopoly Inbox
payload.description: 搜索并发送邮件和消息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mailopoly brings supported email accounts and messaging services into one unified inbox. Connect Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Microsoft 365, iCloud Mail, Yahoo Mail, or a compatible IMAP mailbox. Search across connected accounts, read complete emails and attachment text, catch up on new mail, and draft or send email from a connected account.

Mailopoly analyzes connected email to surface priorities and extract tasks, meetings and events, invoices and bills with amounts and due dates, and parcel deliveries. Organize messages with smart lists, troubleshoot syncing and reconnection, and receive an optional daily briefing.

Mailopoly also supports authorized connections to Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram. Messages from connected services appear alongside email, can be searched in the same inbox, and can be answered in their original service.

A Mailopoly account is required.
payload.longDescription:
Mailopoly 将支持的电子邮件账户和消息服务整合到一个统一收件箱中。连接 Gmail、Google Workspace、Outlook、Microsoft 365、iCloud Mail、Yahoo Mail 或兼容的 IMAP 邮箱。搜索已连接账户、阅读完整邮件和附件文本、查看新邮件，也可以从已连接账户起草或发送邮件。

Mailopoly 会分析已连接的邮件，提取优先事项、任务、会议和活动、带金额与到期日的发票和账单，以及包裹配送信息。你可以通过智能列表整理消息、排查同步和重新连接问题，并选择接收每日简报。

Mailopoly 还支持授权连接 Slack、Microsoft Teams、WhatsApp、TikTok、Facebook 和 Instagram。来自已连接服务的消息会与电子邮件一起显示，可在同一收件箱中搜索，并能在原服务中回复。

需要 Mailopoly 账户。

payload.name: Brevo
payload.description: 访问营销活动与联系人
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Brevo to analyze email campaign performance and A/B test results, look up contacts, and explore audience segments in plain language, all without leaving your conversation. ChatGPT can also generate HTML email templates, draft email campaigns, and draft SMS campaigns, saved directly to your Brevo account for you to review before sending. ChatGPT will never send or schedule email campaigns, and will never delete anything on your behalf. Available on all Brevo plans.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Brevo 后，你可以用日常语言分析电子邮件营销活动的表现和 A/B 测试结果、查找联系人并探索受众细分，全程无需离开当前对话。ChatGPT 还可以生成 HTML 邮件模板、起草电子邮件营销活动和 SMS 营销活动，并直接保存到你的 Brevo 账户，供你审核后再发送。ChatGPT 绝不会代你发送或安排电子邮件营销活动，也不会代你删除任何内容。所有 Brevo 套餐均可使用。

payload.name: Rhythm AI Personality Tuner
payload.description: 调整 ChatGPT 与你交谈的方式
payload.summaryOriginal: Tune how ChatGPT talks to you
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Everyone has a Rhythm — a way they like to be talked to.

Rhythm AI Personality Tuner lets you shape ChatGPT's voice to match yours. Five quick cards, fifteen sliders, about a minute: choose how warm or professional it should feel, how direct, how much detail, whether it should challenge your thinking or validate first, hold you accountable or keep things gentle. When you finish, ChatGPT starts speaking your rhythm right there in the conversation — and a before-and-after preview shows you the difference.

Prefer it straight? Your rhythm can say so. Turn down the praise, turn up the pushback, and get answers that tell you what you need to hear — not just what you want to hear.

Your rhythm tunes fifteen dimensions of how ChatGPT communicates, including the ones that matter when a conversation gets personal: emotional awareness, encouragement, and the kind of support you actually want in the moment.

Save your rhythm with a free Rhythm account to keep it. It follows you into new conversations — just @-mention Rhythm to bring it along — and into the Rhythm app, a space to reflect, process, and grow at your own pace. Tune it in either place; it stays in sync.
payload.longDescription:
每个人都有自己的 Rhythm——也就是喜欢别人如何与自己交谈。

Rhythm AI Personality Tuner 可让你调整 ChatGPT 的表达方式，使其符合你的偏好。通过五张快速卡片和十五个滑块，约一分钟即可设置：希望语气多温暖或多专业、表达多直接、细节多丰富、是挑战你的想法还是先表示认同、是督促你负责还是语气温和。完成后，ChatGPT 会立即在当前对话中按照你的节奏表达，并通过前后对比预览展示差异。

喜欢直言不讳？你的 Rhythm 可以体现这一点。减少夸赞、增加质疑，让回答告诉你需要听到的内容，而不只是你想听的内容。

你的 Rhythm 可调整 ChatGPT 沟通方式的十五个维度，包括在私人话题对话中至关重要的方面：情绪觉察、鼓励方式，以及你当下真正需要的支持类型。

创建免费的 Rhythm 账户即可保存你的 Rhythm。它会随你进入新的对话——只需提及 @Rhythm 即可调用——也会同步到 Rhythm 应用中；在那里你可以按自己的节奏反思、整理思绪并成长。无论在哪一处调整，都会保持同步。

payload.name: AI Roleplay Chat Simulator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Talk to anyone, anytime, without the pressure.

This app lets you role play conversations with smart AI people so you can practice before real life.

Pick who you want to talk to, choose a situation, and start chatting. Practice a job interview, a first date, a hard talk with a friend, a meeting with your boss, small talk, customer service, school, travel, or almost any other conversation. The AI answers like a real person and keeps the conversation going. You can try again, change your words, and build confidence one chat at a time.

Talking to people is not always easy. Sometimes you do not know what to say. Sometimes you want to practice before an important moment. This app gives you a safe place to learn. There is no need to feel rushed. You can stop, start again, or try a different answer whenever you want. Every conversation is a chance to learn something new.

Choose from many different people and situations. Talk to a friendly coworker, a teacher, a customer, a neighbor, a family member, a hiring manager, a classmate, a travel guide, a doctor, or create your own character. You can make conversations easy, medium, or hard. You decide how the other person acts. They can be kind, serious, funny, shy, calm, excited, or challenging. Every chat feels fresh because the AI responds to what you say.

Practice for real life in a simple way. Get ready for interviews by answering common questions. Rehearse speeches and presentations. Learn how to ask for help. Practice saying no in a kind way. Prepare for school, work, meetings, travel, shopping, or everyday conversations. Try difficult talks before they happen so you feel more ready when the real moment comes.

Learning is easier when you can practice again and again. If you do not like your answer, try another one. See how different words can change the conversation. Explore different paths and discover new ways to communicate. Every practice session helps you become more comfortable speaking with other people.

The app is great for students, professionals, language learners, job seekers, teachers, parents, travelers, and anyone who wants to become a better communicator. Whether you are preparing for something important or simply want to improve your everyday conversation skills, there is always something new to practice.

You can create your own role play ideas too. Type in a situation, describe the person you want to talk with, and let the AI build a conversation just for you. Make fun stories, serious talks, fantasy adventures, business meetings, classroom lessons, or everyday life scenes. The possibilities are almost endless.

The AI listens to what you say and answers naturally. Each conversation changes based on your choices, making every session feel unique. Explore different ideas, ask questions, solve problems together, or simply enjoy a friendly chat. The more you practice, the more comfortable speaking can become.

Simple to use and easy to enjoy, this app is made for anyone who wants to practice conversations in a safe and private space. Open the app, choose a person, start talking, and learn by doing. Build confidence, improve communication, explore new situations, and get ready for real conversations one message at a time. Whether your goal is better social skills, stronger communication, interview success, language practice, or everyday confidence, this app helps you practice, learn, and grow through natural AI role play conversations whenever you are ready.
payload.longDescription:
随时与任何人交谈，无需承受压力。

这款应用让你与智能 AI 人物进行角色扮演对话，在实际交流前先练习。

选择想交谈的对象和情境，开始聊天。练习求职面试、初次约会、与朋友的艰难谈话、与上司开会、闲聊、客户服务、学校、旅行，或几乎任何其他对话。AI 像真人一样回应，让对话持续下去。你可以重新尝试、调整措辞，通过一次次聊天建立信心。

与人交谈并不总是容易。有时你不知道该说什么，有时你想在重要时刻到来前先练习。这款应用为你提供安全的学习空间，无需感到仓促。你可以随时停止、重新开始或尝试不同的回答。每次对话都是学习新东西的机会。

从众多人物和情境中选择。与友善的同事、老师、客户、邻居、家人、招聘经理、同学、导游、医生交谈，或创建自己的角色。你可以将对话设为简单、中等或困难。由你决定对方的表现：亲切、严肃、幽默、害羞、平静、兴奋或富有挑战性。AI 会根据你说的话回应，因此每次聊天都有新鲜感。

用简单的方式练习真实生活中的交流。回答常见问题，为面试做好准备。排练演讲和演示。学习如何请求帮助，练习如何友善地拒绝。为学校、工作、会议、旅行、购物或日常对话做好准备。在艰难谈话发生之前先试一试，让你在真正面对时更有准备。

反复练习让学习更容易。如果不满意自己的回答，就换一种。看看不同措辞如何改变对话。探索不同的发展方向，发现新的沟通方式。每次练习都能帮助你更自在地与他人交谈。

这款应用适合学生、专业人士、语言学习者、求职者、教师、家长、旅行者，以及任何想提高沟通能力的人。无论你在为重要事情做准备，还是只想改善日常会话技巧，总有新的内容可以练习。

你也可以创建自己的角色扮演创意。输入情境，描述想与之交谈的人，让 AI 为你构建专属对话。创作有趣的故事、严肃的谈话、奇幻冒险、商务会议、课堂教学或日常生活场景。可能性几乎无穷无尽。

AI 会听取你说的话并自然回应。每次对话都会根据你的选择变化，让每次练习都独一无二。探索不同想法、提出问题、共同解决问题，或只是享受友好的聊天。练习越多，交谈就能越自在。

这款应用简单易用、轻松有趣，面向所有想在安全、私密空间中练习对话的人。打开应用，选择人物，开始交谈，在实践中学习。通过一条条消息建立信心、改善沟通、探索新情境，为真实对话做好准备。无论目标是提升社交技能、增强沟通能力、成功面试、练习语言还是建立日常自信，这款应用都能让你在准备好时，通过自然的 AI 角色扮演对话练习、学习和成长。
